Connect your AI tutor

SAIT uses a secure Vercel backend to call Google Gemini. Your API key stays on the server and is never entered into this page. Add GEMINI_API_KEY in your Vercel project settings, then redeploy.

Security note: requests and any selected uploaded-note excerpts are sent to Gemini for processing. Do not upload confidential information. The backend includes basic input limits, but for a public production app you should also add user authentication, usage quotas, and stronger rate limiting.
